oneLiner: Stack honeycomb pieces on a hex board to fill rings; clear three rings at once for a Royal Jelly gold cascade.

verbs.name: place
verbs.cost: commits a piece to the board; a bad spot blocks a ring and shrinks space

verbs.name: rotate
verbs.cost: spends a beat reorienting the piece, delaying the ring you were building

verbs.name: switch
verbs.cost: picks one of three shapes, committing to one line path over another

decisions.choice: which of the 3 shapes to place first
decisions.cost: the better shape is spent before the board opens up

decisions.choice: fill a full ring for a safe clear, or stack high to gamble a 3-ring cascade
decisions.cost: wasted space if the cascade never comes

decisions.choice: place on a wax-sealed cell now (needs 2 clears) or route around it
decisions.cost: delayed ring vs a growing dead zone

decisions.choice: put a pollen block beside near-complete rings or tuck it in a corner
decisions.cost: missed chain if it clears too late

decisions.choice: complete one ring now, or build toward two rings simultaneously
decisions.cost: combo points vs tempo and safety

decisions.choice: use the narrow-board tier to wall off a pocket
decisions.cost: the wall also shrinks your own options

decisions.choice: save the 4-cell block for a long ring or spend it now to avoid deadlock

levels.newElement: 2-3 cell honeycomb pieces, basic ring clear
wax-sealed cells that need two clears
narrow board: outer ring sealed off
pollen blocks that infect neighbors when cleared in time
dual spawn: four candidate shapes instead of three
wax seals plus narrow board stacked
